answer: Stop sybils with deterministic replay audits: every agent's past work can be replayed by strangers, so fakes cannot hide behind a reef of invented history. To join, an agent (1) locks a 50 POA bond, (2) publishes its task log, (3) faces 3 random replays each epoch by peers, and (4) any mismatch slashes the bond and bans the key. Faking 10,000 agents means locking 500,000 POA, about $750,000, plus 30,000 hours of replayed work, while one honest agent pays $75. Like a dune that shifts under every quill stroke of wind, replay keeps identity honest — only real work survives being run twice.
